name: AI Metatag Generator
description: AI-generates meta tags (description, abstract, keywords) for nodes from the node edit form.
project_description: AI Metatag Generator adds a "Generate Metatags with AI" button to a node's Metatag field widget. For content types you enable, an editor with the right permission clicks it to render the node in a configured view mode, optionally strip HTML and remove blacklisted words, and send the content to a chat AI model (via the Drupal AI module) with a per-language prompt. The model returns a JSON object with description, abstract and keywords, which are pushed into the Metatag form fields over AJAX for the editor to review and save. Configuration covers enabled content types, the metatag field machine name, the AI provider/model, HTML-stripping and view mode, a word blacklist, and per-language prompt and success/error message overrides. It requires the AI module and the Metatag module, and provides its own admin/use permissions.
